REBRANDING STRATEGY
In May 2024, we embarked on a rebranding strategy, transitioning
from Colombo Fort Hotels to Fort Resorts. The original brand
name was inspired by our parent company, Colombo Fort Land &
Building. However, as we operate three well-established resorts,
Sigiriya Village, Sigiriya, The Palms, Beruwala, and Club Palm Bay,
Marawila, we felt that the term Colombo Fort Hotels conveyed
an impression of city-based properties. In contrast, Fort Resorts
more accurately reflects the character and positioning of our
